definition.text: Cloth made of black goats’ hair, coarse, rough, and thick, used for sacks, and also worn by mourners (Gen. 37:34; 42:25; 2 Sam. 3:31; Esther 4:1, 2; Ps. 30:11, etc.), and as a sign of repentance (Matt. 11:21). It was put upon animals by the people of Nineveh (Jonah 3:8).

lemmas.kjv: be able to put on, be afraid, appointed, gird

lemmas.gloss: the waist or small of the back
to tear the hair and beat the breasts
